newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish 1997 state budget sees 3.0 pct GDP growth.
newsitem.headline: Danish 1997 state budget sees 3.0 pct GDP growth.

text.p: The Danish government forecast in its 1997 draft state budget that gross domestic product growth would rise to 3.0 percent in 1997 from 2.8 percent in 1995 and a projected 1.8 percent this year.

"Following a brief period of disappointing economic growth, there are indications that the economic outlook is about to brighten," Finance Minister Mogens Lykketoft said in a statement outlining his proposals, yet to be ratified by parliament.

"The latest figures for 1996 show a higher than expected growth rate during the first part of the year and even higher growth rates are projected for the second half of 1996. For 1997 growth is expected to reach about three percent," he said. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
